name: koishi-plugin-group-assistant
description: 面向 Koishi 的群聊准入、内容治理与 AI 审核插件

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('lib',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('tsconfig.tsbuildinfo',{force:true})" && tsc --pretty false && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:koishi --outfile=lib/index.js && node -e "require('@koishijs/client/lib').build(process.cwd()).catch(err=>{console.error(err);process.exitCode=1})"
